observation.visible_scene: A turbulent open flame burning low against a black background, sitting on a pale curved surface (the rim of a pan or dish) visible along the bottom and right edges. The fire has an intensely bright yellow-white core surrounded by orange-red tongues and a growing grey-orange smoke plume to the right. Several small dark silhouetted fragments (unburnt or charred bits) appear embedded in or above the bright core.
visible_changes: The bright core continuously flickers, expands and contracts, and its centroid wanders within the frame (initially center-left, later re-forming center and right-of-center) rather than translating as one rigid body.
The overall flame mass deforms and tilts: the long plume of flame swings between leaning left (early/mid frames) and rising more vertically (late frames).
The smoke/ember region on the right side thickens and drifts, partially obscuring the curved rim in several frames.
The small dark fragments within the flame shift position and orientation relative to the bright core, being carried and re-exposed by the turbulent flow.
Luminance pulses: the yellow core dims into a diffuse orange glow (around t=0.28-0.60) then brightens again into a sharp yellow mass (around t=0.68-0.84 and t=1.28-1.44).
outside_clip_unknowns: The identity of the burning material and the ignition event that started the fire before t=0.
Whether combustion continues, dies down, or is extinguished after t=1.60.
The exact nature of the curved surface (pan, dish, or container wall).
uncertain_details: Camera motion is uncertain: the background is almost entirely black, so the slight apparent shift of the curved rim could be minor camera movement or simply the flame and smoke revealing/hiding it.
It is unclear whether the dark fragments are loose pieces being lifted by the flame or fixed objects viewed through the fire.
The boundary between flame and smoke is blurred by motion blur, making precise shape tracking unreliable.
